title: ISRO URSC Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Indian Space Research Organization ISRO has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Examination of Technician-B, Heavy Vehicle Driver-A, Light Vehicle Driver-A, Staff Card Driver-A Posts. This recruitment is for 61 positions. The ISRO application form has started on 24 October 2026 , and candidates can apply until 13 November 2026 . Candidates must check the complete details for ISRO URSC Various Post Recruitment 2026 Provided below. ( Advt. No. URSC/04/2026 )
